newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen oil ministry in labour dispute with Hunt Oil.
newsitem.headline: Yemen oil ministry in labour dispute with Hunt Oil.

text.p: Yemen's oil and mineral resources ministry is in a labour dispute with private U.S. firm Hunt Oil over the employment of foreign rather than Yemeni workers, a ministry official said on Thursday.
"Hunt intends to bring 120 foreigners to work with the company in its project in Yemen," the official told Reuters.
"The move caused a dispute with the ministry because this number of people will replace Yemeni employees...The move violates contracts signed with Hunt," he added.
The official said Yemen would insist that Hunt hire Yemenis to make room for hundreds of graduates trained in the field of oil and minerals.

Hunt was the first oil company to discover and produce oil in Yemen in the early 1980s. Hunt operates with Exxon as the country's second biggest producer, pumping around 170,000 barrels per day (bpd) of Yemen's total 385,000 bpd output.
The company is currently working on a concession in the governorate of Marib.
